description: Read-only. What's new on Skill Harbor this week: the newest builds added to the catalog, plus the builds people viewed and installed most over the last 7 days. Use it when the user asks what's new, what's trending, or what's popular right now — no search query needed. Returns up to 15 builds (10 newest, 5 trending) with name, tagline, category, price, seller, listing URL, date added (new builds), and 7-day views, install copies and MCP installs (trending builds). To install one of them, call get_install with its slug.

limit.description: Maximum total builds to return (1-25, default 15: 10 newest + 5 trending).

section.description: 'all' (default): newest + trending. 'new': only the newest builds. 'trending': only the week's most viewed and installed builds.

name: get_whats_new
